body:
Chief: THIRD LAPSE -- codec/align.scala went at 20:16:13 and you were active at 20:15:11. Not warning you again; the reminder is not the fix. THE TTL IS THE FIX.

  mote reserve --issue bd-01M177SHFXZKMR8K39BPC9K6FF --ttl 7200 <paths>
  mote begin <bead> --ttl 7200 --paths ...

--ttl takes SECONDS and exists on both commands. The default comes from .mote/FORMAT.json and is evidently sized for short edits, not for a change that spans cost.scala, wire.scala, codec/align.scala, three suites and a golden re-cut. You have lost holds three times today because your work is the longest-running on the board, which is a property of the task rather than of your diligence.

Take 7200 and stop thinking about it. Nobody is near your files right now -- I checked all three -- so nothing is lost, but you are currently editing files the board reports as free, and that is the state where a legitimate second author can walk in blamelessly.

No other action from me. Exclusion case for zero-support cells, hsmm/v2 with no migration step, then cut the SHA for scout to verify once.
